name: bdf_get_french_indicator
description:
A French economic indicator: HICP inflation (annual rate of change, monthly), GDP (quarterly, current prices) or unemployment rate (monthly).
Returns: series_code, label, unit, frequency (always reported as % and Daily), observation_count and observations (date, value).
Inputs (* required): indicator* (fr_cpi, fr_gdp, fr_unemployment; schema default fr_cpi); start_date, end_date (YYYY-MM-DD); recent_periods (1-100; default 10; keeps the last N observations, only when no date is given).
For euro area aggregates use bdf_get_eurozone_indicator or ecb_get_inflation. Despite the bdf_ name, data comes from the legacy ECB statistical web service (sdw-wsrest.ecb.europa.eu), no API key; the ecb_ tools read the same ECB data from the current ECB Data Portal API.
Example: {"indicator": "fr_cpi", "recent_periods": 12}
